# Handodle

`Handodle-Regular.ttf` is Handodle by Putra Novembria Candra Kusuma
(Putracetol Studio), ©2019, as distributed in its demo build. It is converted
into `src/text/fonts/handodle.ts` by `scripts/gen-outline-font.mjs`.

There is no licence file to copy here: the font's own licence field points to
the terms of the store it was bought from. See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md at the
repository root for what this build is and what that means for
redistribution.
